notes: The rewrite is a genuinely impressive DFW pastiche — the recursive footnote-logic, the etymological digressions, the self-implicating corporate 'we,' the specific Duluth detail, all land with real precision — but it is functionally unpublishable as an actual recall notice, since its meta-commentary on corporate remorse would be read as mockery of affected customers and would almost certainly worsen legal and reputational exposure rather than contain it.
